name: Callum's dev tools (no-mistakes, treehouse, Claude Code CLI)
description: Installs the tooling behind Callum's dev flow: the no-mistakes pipeline, the treehouse worktree pool, and the Claude Code CLI. Installs run as the remote user at post-create time, so per-user tools land in the user's home exactly as a hand-run install would.

installClaudeCode.description: Install the Claude Code CLI globally via npm (requires a Node-capable base image).

installNoMistakes.description: Install the no-mistakes pipeline CLI (binary release from kunchenguid/no-mistakes).

installTreehouse.description: Install treehouse, the reusable worktree pool for parallel agents (binary release from kunchenguid/treehouse).
